title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
description: Breadth plus a production platform: from a Linux shell to a system you deploy and operate yourself.
descriptionAr: اتساع المعرفة مع منصة إنتاج: من سطر أوامر Linux إلى نظام تنشره وتشغّله بنفسك.

phases.title: Orientation
phases.deliverable: Understand the system you are going to build, and how the repository, labs and capstone fit together.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.deliverable: Operate a Linux server, follow a network failure to its cause, and collaborate in Git without losing work.

phases.title: Build & Containers
phases.deliverable: Build and run the application locally in production-shaped containers.

phases.title: Cloud (AWS)
phases.deliverable: Understand and provision the AWS primitives the platform needs — network, identity, registry, compute.

phases.title: Infrastructure as Code
phases.deliverable: Reproduce the whole AWS environment from code, and configure the build host with no manual step.

phases.title: Kubernetes
phases.deliverable: Run the application on Kubernetes with workloads, networking, storage and security in place.

phases.title: CI/CD
phases.deliverable: Turn a source change into a tested, scanned, immutable image in the registry.

phases.title: GitOps
phases.deliverable: Deliver that image by changing Git, and let the cluster reconcile itself to it.

phases.title: Observability
phases.deliverable: Answer whether the platform is healthy, and investigate it when it is not.

phases.title: Cloud Native Security
phases.deliverable: Reduce risk across source, build, artifact, deployment and runtime.

phases.title: Production & SRE
phases.deliverable: Diagnose failure, recover the system, and reason about its reliability and cost.

productionProject.title: Cloud DevOps Capstone
productionProject.summary: Three microservices in three languages, taken from source to a monitored, GitOps-managed deployment on AWS EKS: Terraform provisions the AWS infrastructure, Ansible configures the build host, Jenkins builds and scans, Argo CD reconciles, Prometheus watches.

contentGaps: Software delivery fundamentals: artifacts, environments, versioning and rollback as the model CI/CD implements
CI/CD testing and quality gates as a concept, so Jenkins and Actions read as implementations of it
SRE fundamentals: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and postmortems, before Chaos Engineering
Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry — the third observability pillar
